maximum adverse excursion.def: The worst mark-to-market loss a trade shows at any point while it is open, abbreviated MAE. It is often larger than the loss at the exit.

maximum favorable excursion.def: The best mark-to-market gain a trade shows at any point while it is open, abbreviated MFE.

exchange-traded note.def: An exchange-traded product built as a note rather than a fund, abbreviated ETN. The VIX products VXX and UVXY are ETNs, and they decay structurally.
